```sql
SELECT CAST(p."CreaionDate" AS DATE) AS question_date, COUNT(*) AS new_questions
FROM main."posts" p
WHERE p."PostTypeId" = 1
  AND p."CreaionDate" >= '2013-06-01'
  AND p."CreaionDate" < '2013-07-01'
GROUP BY CAST(p."CreaionDate" AS DATE)
ORDER BY question_date;
```
